items.text: Managed 4 Azure SaaS production environments and 5+ non-production environments across development, integration, staging and UAT, using App Service, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, AKS, Azure Managed Redis, Storage Accounts, Azure SQL, Key Vault and Private Endpoints.

Migrated a customer's production caching layer from Azure Cache for Redis to Azure Managed Redis and moved the new instance into Terraform management so the change caused no disruption to dependent applications.

Migrated production resources across Azure subscriptions with minimal downtime. Used AzCopy for Blob and File Share data and performed export/import for Azure SQL, which improved cost efficiency and separated environments.
Supported 5+ customer deployments of the company's product through Azure Marketplace and Terraform, customizing configurations to each customer's requirements.
Implemented disaster recovery for production Azure SQL databases using geo-replication failover with SID-matched logins, so applications could log in again without remapping users after failover.

Built and maintained reusable Terraform modules in a unified IaC repository to provision AKS, ACI, Azure Container Apps, App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Managed Redis, Front Door, Application Gateway, NAT Gateway, Bastion and Private Endpoints.
Moved a customer's production workloads from Azure Container Instances (ACI) to Azure Container Apps (ACA) using Terraform, which improved scalability, revision management and day-to-day operations.
Brought existing production infrastructure under Terraform management by importing networking, private DNS, databases, Front Door, AKS and 15+ other resources into Terraform state.
Refactored a monolithic Azure Container Instance deployment into four independent container groups, with conditional deployment logic for multiple products.

Fixed AzureRM provider compatibility issues in the SaaS production Terraform code by updating deprecated and breaking resource arguments, restoring clean terraform plan and apply runs with no unintended changes.
Built Azure DevOps release pipelines that deploy the latest and stable container images from 10 ACR repositories to Azure App Service and AKS with minimal downtime.
Administered production AKS clusters, managing deployments, ConfigMaps, Secrets, CronJobs, persistent volumes and claims (PV/PVC), services and ingress to keep workloads available and scalable.

Upgraded AKS clusters from 1.34.8 to 1.35.7 in non-production and SaaS production through Azure DevOps pipelines with minimal downtime, temporarily adjusting Pod Disruption Budgets for stateful workloads (Redis, ChromaDB) and validating changes with server-side dry runs.
Created Kubernetes service accounts, namespace-scoped RBAC role bindings and service account tokens to set up Azure DevOps Kubernetes service connections for automated AKS deployments.
Contributed to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification through Vanta, covering policy documentation, automated evidence collection, centralized audit logging and mapping technical controls to policy.

Configured custom Wiz deployments to scan container image tags in 10 production Azure Container Registry (ACR) repositories. Tracked vulnerabilities through scheduled daily scans and on-demand custom scans, which gave the team continuous visibility of CVEs in production images.
Fixed a high-severity remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-111497) in the Brotli decoder on Azure DevOps build agents by upgrading the Node.js and .NET runtimes to patched versions.

Moved application workloads from secret-based authentication to system-assigned managed identities. This removed stored database, Redis and storage credentials and allowed Redis access key authentication to be turned off.
Managed Entra ID role assignments, App Registrations and Key Vault access policies for 6 teams.
Automated pause and resume of Microsoft Fabric capacities with Azure Functions based on capacity unit (CU) utilization, reducing Fabric capacity costs by ~40%.
Reduced non-production compute costs by ~30% using Bash scripts with Azure CLI that stop or deallocate VMs, AKS clusters and container workloads after each test cycle.
Automated scheduled start/stop of Azure SQL and writeback databases and virtual machines with Azure Automation Account runbooks, removing manual on/off work.
Automated Grafana service recovery on a Linux VM with a Bash restart script scheduled via cron every two days.
